snippet.title: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2686820/_/

isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey is a 2D action game. 
Kijino, a cat-eared adventurer with two tails (Nekomata), embarks on a journey to Isekizima (Ruins Island of dreams and romance: as it was written in the tourist brochure). 
Explore ruins buried in the forest while enjoying ethnic music.
